Village Bike & Fitness Tuesday Night Road Ride

Grand Rapids, MI · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

Village Bike & Fitness Tuesday Night Road Ride is a road group ride in Grand Rapids, MI. It rolls every Tuesday at 7:00 pm from Riverside Park boat launch (Monroe & Knapp). Pace: 15–16 mph average with regroup stops. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Village Bike & Fitness Tuesday Night Road Ride group ride

A shop-led road ride on rolling roads toward Rockford and Cannonsburg and around downtown. It teaches group skills like calling hazards and riding a paceline. Helmets required, lights recommended.
